title: Lake Ngami · observed surface water
description: Digital Earth Africa WOfS annual summary, sampled and reprojected. Clear-observation count ≥ 5. Water presence is not water quality or water availability.

title: Africa · heat laboratory
description: Analytic seasonal temperature field. Not ERA5, UTCI, wet-bulb temperature, or an observed heat event.

title: Africa · air-quality laboratory
description: Invented aerosol field for exposure reasoning. Not CAMS data, measured pollution, or a health assessment.

title: Africa · food & water laboratory
description: Invented rainfall field for seasonality and threshold sensitivity. Not CHIRPS, crop yield, or a food-insecurity forecast.

title: Coastal futures · illustrative terrain
description: Invented terrain near Durban coordinates. No real DEM, vertical datum, drainage, tides, defenses, or flood hydraulics. Height threshold is not inundation risk.

title: Water quality · optical proxy laboratory
description: Invented reflectance plume at Lake Victoria coordinates. Reflectance is not pathogen concentration, turbidity calibration, chlorophyll, or drinking-water safety.

title: Abidjan · AR6 sea-level projection
description: AR6 v20210809, wf_1e / SSP5-8.5, median of all 20,000 samples per year. One-degree regional projection locations; no additional land/ocean mask. Background land motion included. Not a flood map or canonical IPCC p-box. Extruded height is a visual scale, not terrain.
source: Garner et al. (2021), doi:10.5281/zenodo.5914709; FACTS; IPCC AR6 WG1 Ch9

title: Lagos / Apapa vicinity / embedding similarity
description: TESSERA v1.1 dClimate annual embeddings, compared with a fixed 2025 center-pixel vector. Similarity is not a class probability, flood depth, or climate trend. Query spacing about 42 m; values come from individual 10 m pixels. Vertical height is a score, not terrain.
source: TESSERA v1.1 / dClimate; Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2
statistic: cosine similarity to one fixed 2025 reference vector
sampling: Individual 10 m source pixels at geographic query centers spaced about 42 m; not area averages.

title: Senegal River valley teaching window / FTW field probability

source: Taylor Geospatial and collaborators; Microsoft AI for Good Research Lab; Copernicus Sentinel-2; Source Cooperative
sampling: Contiguous 128 x 128 native pixels, no resampling. Full polygons intersecting the pixel-edge extent; polygons are not clipped. Geometry and provider area/perimeter are retained.

title: Northern Ghana and neighboring savannas · SeasFire burned area
description: GWIS burned area allocated by ignition date, harmonized in SeasFire v0.4. Native 0.25 degree cells; final annual bins are shorter. Historical estimate, not active-fire alerts, a forecast, or terrain.
sampling: Contiguous 16x16 native 0.25 degree pixels, all 966 periods. No spatial resampling. Raw source values retained in NPZ; availability mask applied by lesson helpers and lab cube preparation.
temporal_support: Source timestamps start nominal 8-day bins, reset January 1 each year; final annual bins have 5 or 6 days. GWIS allocated by fire ignition date. 2001 unavailable, not zero fire.
